fields.description: Pipeline state. A Select over the canonical state set so it validates on save and powers the Task Pipeline Kanban (design 65b). Driven by the dispatcher/runner/reconciler, not by hand.
fields.label: Workflow State
fields.options:
Pending
Assigned
Executing
Review
Completed
Blocked
Cancelled

fields.description: mechanical = run required_skills in sequence (no model). agentic = the matched profile runs a real governed turn (design 60, Q2). milestone = never auto-dispatched; completed by events (gate decisions) or humans.
fields.label: Execution Mode

fields.description: The RandomPack backend's reference for this task/phase (write-back key). Empty = no write-back.
fields.label: Backend Ref

fields.description: AND-gated dependencies: this task dispatches only when ALL linked tasks are Completed.
fields.label: Depends On

fields.description: Set by the dispatcher at Pending → Assigned. The reconciler uses this + a 30s grace to detect Assigned-but-never-picked-up tasks (lost enqueue) and re-fire the runner trigger.
fields.label: Assigned At

fields.description: Updated by the runner during execution (every 30s for agentic, per skill boundary for mechanical). The reconciler treats Executing tasks without a fresh heartbeat as runner_lost (15 min default) and Blocks them, raising a Failure Issue.
fields.label: Last Heartbeat At

fields.description: Idempotent claim token written by the runner in a single check-and-set transaction (Assigned → Executing). A duplicate trigger sees a non-empty token and exits cleanly — the runner becomes at-least-once-trigger / exactly-once-effect.
fields.label: Executing Token

fields.description: Structured reason a Pending or Blocked task is parked (e.g. no_profile_for_skills:create-brand-direction, profile_has_no_llm_provider, dependency_failed). Surfaced on the Pipeline Health page; the reconciler clears it once the underlying condition changes.
fields.label: Blocked Reason

fields.description: Count of automated retries the reconciler has issued for transient failures (oom, timeout, runner_lost). Capped at 3; beyond that the task stays Blocked for a human.
fields.label: Retry Count

fields.description: The Chat Message session_id that triggered this task, if it was born from a conversation. On a terminal transition the agent writes a reply back to this session (design 62). Empty = no chat report-back (e.g. RandomPack pipeline tasks, whose report-back is the backend write-back).
fields.label: Originating Session

fields.description: The surface the originating session lives on (raven / cli / telegram / ...). Used to route the report-back Chat Message.
fields.label: Originating Platform

fields.description: The parent Task that delegated this one (design 69). NULL for top-level tasks and chat-originated delegations. The chain parent_task → parent_task forms the delegation graph, queryable via a recursive CTE.
fields.label: Parent Task

fields.description: Design 75: the domain work-item DocType this task advances (e.g. Brand Brief). With work_item_name it links the Task to the record whose Frappe Workflow drives the pipeline. Empty for freeform / chat-originated tasks.
fields.label: Work Item DocType

fields.description: Design 75: the specific work-item record (Dynamic Link on work_item_doctype) this task advances.
fields.label: Work Item

fields.description: Design 75: the Friday Workflow Transition Meta phase_key this task executes. On completion the engine resolves the transition by (workflow, from_state, action) via this key and fires the next state — never keyed on the target state (back-edge safe).
fields.label: Phase Key

fields.description: Planned start (from the pipeline plan or derived from dependencies). Drives the Gantt view.
fields.label: Expected Start Date

fields.description: Planned finish. Drives the Gantt view.
fields.label: Expected End Date

fields.description: 0/50/100 by workflow_state (Pending / Executing / terminal). Powers Gantt + Kanban progress bars (design 65d).
fields.label: Progress

fields.description: Bar color in Gantt/Kanban, defaulted from the assigned agent profile.
fields.label: Color

fields.description: Mirrors execution_mode == milestone. A milestone is a gate, not work.
fields.label: Is Milestone

fields.description: Execution duration in milliseconds, from the result envelope on completion.
fields.label: Duration (ms)

fields.description: LLM spend for this task's run, from the result envelope (design 65d). Renders blank when usage telemetry is absent — never a fabricated 0.
fields.label: Cost (USD)
